newsitem.title: USA: GeneMedicine gets $4 mln Corange investment.
newsitem.headline: GeneMedicine gets $4 mln Corange investment.

text.p: GeneMedicine Inc said on Tuesday it sold $4 million in common stock to Corange Ltd, in accordance with their 1995 alliance.
Corange, which owns Boehringer Mannheim Group, is now GeneMedicine's largest shareholder with 10 percent of the company's shares.

The two companies' agreement calls for quarterly research and development payments of $1.25 million by Corange to GeneMedicine, and annual $4 million equity investments. To date, Corange's total investment in GeneMedicine is $10.85 million in research and development funding and $12 million in equity investments.
On Monday GeneMedicine said it received U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval to begin human clinical trials for its IL-2 cancer gene medicine, intended to treat head and neck cancer.
